temperature_c.description: Biological temperature inside the bioreactor vessel. Exceeding 39.0°C causes irreversible protein denaturing and batch ruin.

bioreactor_rpm.description: Mechanical rotation speed of internal impellers providing dissolved oxygen to cellular cultures.

pressure_psi.description: Vessel positive pressure safeguarding the sterile environment against airborne bio-contamination.

ph_level.description: Culture medium acidity/alkalinity balancing cellular metabolism and enzymatic yield.
